Attribution: EFF's Long Wordlist by the Electronic Frontier Foundation,
licensed under CC BY 4.0. Source and license links are provided above.

Changes made for this distribution: the five-dice lookup codes were removed
and the 7,776 words were serialized as a UTF-8 JSON array. Original word
spellings and order are preserved. No words were added, removed or edited.
